note: A CONFLICT-FREE merge runs NO hook at all; a CONFLICTED one runs pre-commit. core.hooksPath=scripts/hooks holds ONLY pre-commit, and git runs pre-merge-commit (which does not exist here) for an auto-committed merge, pre-commit only for the manual resolution commit. So the EASY merge is the UNGUARDED one, the inverse of intuition. Measured absorbing 56 commits into the-radiation: 4 conflicts, all generated, forced a manual commit and the hook caught 7 wrong lines in docs/audits/type-audit-report.md. Meanwhile TWO artifacts merged WRONG WITHOUT CONFLICTING, and book/src/reference/concept-registry-generated.md silently DROPPED all four person predicates (is-person, person-born, person-died, person-founded). Only make rebaseline found it. No-conflict and correctly-merged are unrelated properties for generated files: ALWAYS regenerate after an absorption, never infer freshness from a clean merge.
